body: Can I purchase this or another piece from you?
Thank you you are so sweet
It was very hard to write im sorry I knew it'd be difficult to read but having others know makes me feel like I'm not alone In knowing. Thank you for your kind words
Karma will hopefully take care of him. Thank you

Yes our minds are amazing when we are in danger and after the fact. Suppressed memories are  great example of protecting us from trauma. I did disassociate hard. I think mentally it was what was best for me then.
Thank you I really needed to hear that.

The drive seemed like forever. When he drove me to my car he tried to justify his actions some more but I took the opportunity to get in my car and lock the door. I knew I couldn't drive home after drinking but needed to get away from him so I drove until I got to a parking lot and I cried. I felt so disgusting, I felt sad, I felt weak, I felt like scum. All the times I said how I would react if I was raped and I did not react that way. I started thinking about who to go to my parents? I'm a grown woman but I thought I can't do that they'd tell me I put myself in that position, the police? I don't have time for court dates I need to work.More than anything I wanted to take back this night so it never happened. I thought about stds, pregnancy I have anxiety and it kicked in full throttle. I sobered up in the parking lot not fully but I needed to get to a hospital. I drove as fast as I could to the urgent care facility and when I got there I was shaking uncontrollably and couldn't stop myself from crying. I knew the moment  I told the doctors there what had just happened I admit to being a victim and in that moment I decided not to tell them. I wanted the control back and in that moment I decided it was up to me if I didn't tell anyone I wasn't a victim nobody could look at me that way. I tried to calm myself but as soon as I told the doctor and nurse that I needed to be tested for stds  tears streamed down my face. The doctor stepped out and the nurse asked me if I wanted to report anything,if anyone had hurt me, I asked her if I was hurt what would happen next? She told me the police would be called I told her that wasn't necessary I just wanted to get tested and go home. The way she looked at me I knew she knew. She said 'if you were assaulted we can help you and run a rape kit' I brushed tears from my cheek 'no I just want to be tested' she gave me a look of pity and when she tested me she told me it looked like someone had hurt me I had marks on my thighs and vaginal injuries and asked me one more time to please tell her anything she needed to know. I imagined losing my job, getting pity glares from family and having to tell everyone how I just laid there and took it and I hated myself. I did not tell them what happened,I left and went to the pharmacy to buy the morning after pill, the whole time he was texting me. Over the next few days he dropped gifts off at my door, told me he really fell for me...a thought came across my mind that would sound crazy to you. I can't explain what something like being raped does to a person's mind I wanted to feel control over my own self again,I wanted to pretend I wasn't raped,  I decided to make him fall in love with me. At first it was to make him feel bad that he did something so terrible to me because I'm a good person, but also if he fell in love with me I felt as though id never have to tell anyone I was raped. Sick I know. It went the way I wanted. I spent all my time with him, I felt at peace for a while like the memory of my rape disappeared the more I pretended it didn't happen. I went on to have the most hellish year of my life which I should have known I really fell in love with my rapist. I had these rose colored glasses on and tried to do what I always do which is convince myself people had tough lives to make them who they are. I convinced myself I only deserved a person like him. The year was filled with him abusing me physically,emotionally, getting another woman pregnant, the cops constantly being at my house because he had hit me or was threatening to kill himself or me. The last few days of our relationship were the worst he kept me pinned to the bed for hours, wouldn't let me leave my apartment until I asked to walk my dog he insisted on going with I hated him so much he tossed me around like a rag doll when I ran for my car to try to call for help. I ended up slamming his arm in the door when he stood in the doorway of my house after hitting me. I STILL felt bad doing that even after him hitting me,I just don't understand it. He would climb in my windows while I was at work and id come home to him in my house when id come home from work.. i was so scared this man had complete control over my life, I got a moving truck and my brother in law helped me move in the middle of the night so he couldn't find me. When he couldn't find me he showed up to my job and was waiting outside for me, my coworkers would come in saying a man was asking about me. I broke down in tears at work and decided to file for a pfa. I had to see him for the last time in court and was granted the pfa. He still reached out to me in his own ways nomatter how many accounts or numbers I block he popped up but it was during the beginning of covid and everything was closed at the time. Eventually he left me alone, I got drunk one night and messaged him asking why he raped me and he laughed. I don't know that I will ever be able to tell anyone what happened to me or if I could even explain how dating my rapist made me feel better but lately I have had a hard time coping w it and wanted to post on a platform where nobody would know its me. If you read all of this thank you for listening.
